about: Water records the San Diego Water Board's table of USIBWC spill and transboundary flow events (source ca-sd-regional-board-ibwc-spills, read 2026-11-15, 16 rows) would place its reports on, none of which is on file: no California record in data/waters-*.json is named Tijuana River, Tijuana River Estuary, Smuggler's Gulch, Goat Canyon, Stewart's Drain, Silva Drain or Canyon del Sol. Proposed only; nothing here is a water record. The feed (pipeline/ingest/ca_sd_tijuana_table.py) places a report on a California record of the name it gives (record name or alias) whose box meets the Tijuana River valley (-117.16, 32.50, -116.95, 32.62), so a record built under any slug with that name is picked up on the next run. The Pacific Ocean record (pacific-ocean-ca) exists; no row names it. The table gives no coordinates: the reference points are the USGS names service's, for building the records, never a report's point. Names and identifiers were looked up on 2026-11-15 in the National Map's NHD and geographic names services and the Census TIGERweb hydrography.

rows.name: Tijuana River
rows.nhd: NHD high resolution flowlines of GNIS 255756 'Tijuana River' (34 flowlines meet the valley box, 20.6 km, part in Mexico; reach codes 18070305...), cut to California as the other NHD records are
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 255756, Streams (Mouth) layer of the National Map's geographic names service (mouth and source points as listed)
rows.build: python -m ingest.waters_from_nhd --names research/ca/tijuana-water-records-proposed.json --state CA (one NHD water of this name in CA)
rows.basis: the table's row of Tijuana River Transboundary Flow Events names the river as its discharge location; the canyons below drain to it or to its estuary

rows.name: Tijuana River Estuary
rows.nhd: no named NHD estuary or waterbody: NHD gives only unnamed marsh (FType 466) and pond polygons around the mouth, the river's own flowlines and Oneonta Slough (GNIS 246917, the estuary's northern arm, 32.56534, -117.13115)
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 246917 'Oneonta Slough' (Other Hydrographic Features layer)
rows.build: a hand record: an outline from the Tijuana River National Estuarine Research Reserve boundary (NOAA) or the NHD marsh polygons at the mouth, with alias 'Oneonta Slough'; not buildable by the NHD name pass
rows.basis: no table row names the estuary; it is needed for a modeled path from the river and the canyons to the sea

rows.name: Smuggler's Gulch
rows.nhd: GNIS 249613 'Smuggler Gulch' is a Valley (landform) feature; no NHD flowline carries the name in the valley
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 249613, Landforms layer of the National Map's geographic names service
rows.build: a hand record: the unnamed NHD flowline down the gulch from the border to the Tijuana River, named from GNIS 249613
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for five rows (Spill Events and dry weather Canyon Collector Transboundary Flow Events)

rows.name: Goat Canyon
rows.nhd: GNIS 242756 'Goat Canyon' is a Valley (landform) feature; no NHD flowline carries the name in the valley
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 242756, Landforms layer of the National Map's geographic names service
rows.build: a hand record: the unnamed NHD flowline down the canyon from the border to the estuary, named from GNIS 242756
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for four rows (two at the Goat Canyon Pump Station)

rows.name: Stewart's Drain
rows.nhd: no GNIS or NHD feature of this name in the valley box (queried 2026-11-15)
rows.build: a hand record from a public map of USIBWC's canyon collectors (none read yet); no coordinates guessed
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for two rows (dry weather Canyon Collector Transboundary Flow Events, 2026)

rows.name: Silva Drain
rows.nhd: no GNIS or NHD feature of this name in the valley box (queried 2026-11-15)
rows.build: a hand record from a public map of USIBWC's canyon collectors (none read yet); no coordinates guessed
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for one row (2025-03-21 to 2025-05-21)

rows.name: Canyon del Sol
rows.nhd: no GNIS or NHD feature of this name in the valley box (queried 2026-11-15)
rows.build: a hand record from a public map of USIBWC's canyon collectors (none read yet); no coordinates guessed
rows.basis: the table's discharge location 'Del Sol Canyon Collector' for one row (2025-06-15 to 2025-11-19)
